articles.summary: Savers Value Village, Inc. (the “Company”) today announced that it plans to report its third quarter financial results on November 5, 2026 after market close. On the same day, the Company will host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET to discuss its financial results. Investors and analysts who wish to participate in the call are invited to dial +1 833 461 5787 (international callers, please dial +1 585 542 9983) approximately 10 minutes prior to the start of the call. Please reference Conference ID 419483389 when prompted. A live webcast of the conference call will be available in the investor relations section of the Company’s website, Savers Value Village - Investor Relations . A recorded replay of the call will be available on our website shortly after the conclusion of the call and remain available on our website until November 5, 2027. articles.summary: More than 3.6 billion pounds of reusable goods diverted from landfills and approximately $534 million paid to nonprofit partners from fiscal 2021 through fiscal 2025 Savers Value Village, Inc. (NYSE: SVV) (the “Company”), the largest for-profit thrift operator in the U.S. and Canada for value-priced, pre-owned clothing, accessories and household goods, today released its 2026 Impact Sustainability Report. articles.title: Savers Value Village Highlights the Impact of Reuse in Fifth Annual Impact & Sustainability Report

articles.summary: Featuring Facility and Store Tours Savers Value Village, Inc. (NYSE: SVV) (the “Company”) today announced that it will host an Innovation Day on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. CT in the Minneapolis–St. Paul area. The event will feature a tour of Savers’ Minneapolis Centralized Processing Center (CPC) and a retail store tour. The attendees will get a firsthand look at the Company’s innovation agenda spanning technology and operations, including demonstrations of ThriftIQ. The event will also include a management presentation and question-and-answer session featuring Mark Walsh, Chief Executive Officer; Jubran Tanious, President and Chief Operating Officer; and Michael Maher, Chief Financial Officer. In-person attendance is limited to institutional investors and sell-side analysts. Those interested in attending may request an invitation by contacting ADDO Investor Relations at SVV@addo.com .
